gloss: look of the sky; way things are going

definitions.gloss: look of the sky; movement of clouds
definitions.explanation: The appearance of the sky based on how clouds are moving, especially as an indication of approaching weather.

definitions.gloss: way things are going; signs; outlook; developments
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, the direction a situation is heading, especially when it seems to be turning unfavorable.

examples.japanese: {雲行|くもゆ}きが{怪|あや}しくなってきた。
examples.english: The sky is starting to look threatening.

examples.japanese: {雲行|くもゆ}きを{見|み}て、{傘|かさ}を{持|も}っていくことにした。
examples.english: Looking at the sky, I decided to bring an umbrella.

examples.japanese: {午後|ごご}になって{急|きゅう}に{雲行|くもゆ}きが{変|か}わり、{激|はげ}しい{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: In the afternoon the sky suddenly changed, and heavy rain began to fall.

examples.japanese: {交渉|こうしょう}の{雲行|くもゆ}きが{怪|あや}しい。
{経済|けいざい}の{雲行|くもゆ}きが{悪|わる}くなっている。
{会議|かいぎ}の{雲行|くもゆ}きが{怪|あや}しくなってきたので、{発言|はつげん}を{控|ひか}えることにした。
examples.english: Since the meeting was taking a bad turn, I decided to hold back from commenting.

notes:
USAGE:
The figurative sense (sense 2) is extremely common and often appears with {怪|あや}しい (suspicious, ominous). The expression {雲行|くもゆ}きが{怪|あや}しい can refer to either literal weather or figurative situations going badly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雲行|くもゆ}きが{怪|あや}しい (the sky / situation looks threatening)
- {雲行|くもゆ}きが{変|か}わる (the sky / situation changes)
- {雲行|くもゆ}きを{見|み}る (to watch the sky / assess the situation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {動向|どうこう}: trend, developments — more formal and analytical
- {形勢|けいせい}: situation, state of affairs — often used for competitions or battles
